summary: Ukrainian Navy Neptune missiles struck Russian drone production facilities in Rostov-on-Don and Khabarovsk, targeting tactical UAV manufacturing and FPV drone repair centers. Russia launched a massive overnight missile and drone wave across Ukraine, including cruise missiles toward Zhytomyr and Kremenchuk, and numerous Shahed/Geran-5 systems hitting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, and southern regions. ISW assesses a Russian humanitarian mission in Kostyantynivka as a likely cover for force accumulation to advance on fortified Druzhkivka.
key_points: Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit Russian drone factories in Rostov-on-Don (Ionos plant, Aero-Hit center) and Khabarovsk, destroying tactical UAV production and FPV drone repair facilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/85283)
Russian attacks on Odesa and Zaporizhzhia killed 3 civilians and injured 20, including 5 children, per Ukrainian officials. (Source: @UkraineNow/85282)
Russia launched 2 cruise missiles toward Zhytomyr, 1 toward Kremenchuk, and dozens of Shahed/Geran-5 drones across 10+ Ukrainian regions overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78204, @mon1tor_ua/78209)
ISW assesses Russian humanitarian mission in Kostyantynivka as probable cover for offensive preparations toward Druzhkivka, citing civilian evacuations. (Source: @UkraineNow/85287)
Ukrainian drones struck Volgograd Lukoil refinery (13th attack), Samara pipeline, and Rostov warehouses. (Source: @UkraineNow/85272)
Russian tactical aviation fired guided bombs at Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia regions. (Source: @kpszsu/95867, @kpszsu/95875)
Russia's Rassvet satellite constellation fails: 30 launched, none reached 800km orbit, two deorbited, third launch cancelled. (Source: @UkraineNow/85286)
US House bipartisan group demands Trump restore Ukraine's Starshield access; Poland refuses funding for US weapons for Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/85279, @UkraineNow/85291)

points: Ukrainian Navy launched Neptune missiles at Russian drone infrastructure in Rostov-on-Don, hitting the Ionos tactical strike UAV plant and Aero-Hit service center repairing Veles FPV drones, plus a facility in Khabarovsk. (Source: @UkraineNow/85283)
Ukrainian drones conducted at least the 13th strike on Volgograd Lukoil refinery, also hitting the Samara pipeline (LVDS Samara) and warehouses in Rostov region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85272)
Ukraine's defense sector reports 3,000+ vacancies in one quarter with median salary $2,500, highlighting MilTech growth and civilian-to-defense transition programs. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23999)
105 bipartisan US House members demanded Trump and SpaceX restore full Starshield access for Ukraine amid reported new restrictions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85279)
Ukrainian and Swedish foreign ministers discussed strengthening air defense, energy protection, and fighter jet delivery schedules. (Source: @UkraineNow/85288)
Finland allocated €37.3 million for Ukraine's defense sector and reconstruction, aiming to engage Finnish business in critical infrastructure rebuilding. (Source: @UkraineNow/85275)

Russia launched a massive overnight barrage: 2 cruise missiles (Banderyol) from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv/Zhytomyr, 1 toward Kremenchuk, plus dozens of Shahed/Geran-5 drones across Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78204, @mon1tor_ua/78209, @mon1tor_ua/78208)
Russian strikes on Odesa killed 2 and injured 7; on Zaporizhzhia killed a 17-year-old and injured 13 including 5 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/85282)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs (KABs) against Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia regions in multiple waves. (Source: @kpszsu/95867, @kpszsu/95875, @kpszsu/95850)

Russia's low-orbit Rassvet satellite program faces severe delays: 30 satellites launched but none reached planned 800km altitude, two deorbited, third launch cancelled or postponed due to foreign component dependence and technical issues. (Source: @UkraineNow/85286)
Car explosion in Moscow targeted former Azarov press secretary Serhii Zavorotnyuk, identified in 2020 US Senate report as SVR officer involved in influence campaigns. (Source: @UkraineNow/85276)
Kremlin spokesman Peskov called on NATO to documentally formalize non-expansion eastward. (Source: @UkraineNow/85273)
Russian guided bombs struck Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions; separate strikes hit Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/95867, @kpszsu/95875, @kpszsu/95850)
Jet-powered UAV launched from Donbas (Donetsk region) toward Dnipropetrovsk region, heading to Petropavlivka and Pavlohrad. (Source: @kpszsu/95870)
Strike UAVs observed east of Kharkiv moving southward. (Source: @kpszsu/95849)
Zaporizhzhia region: jet-powered UAV on/past Vilniansk heading toward Zaporizhzhia city. (Source: @kpszsu/95871)
Dnipropetrovsk region air alerts indicated 2 groups of jet-powered UAVs; Zaporizhzhia region had 2 groups jet-powered and 1 strike UAV group. (Source: @eRadarrua/130540, @eRadarrua/130533)
Jet-powered UAVs launched from Bryansk region (Russia) toward Chernihiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/95865)
Chernihiv region air alerts showed 1-2 groups of jet-powered UAVs; specific detections at Mena, Nizhyn, and Nosivka. (Source: @eRadarrua/130532, @eRadarrua/130568)
UAV equipped with mesh-system detected at 2,400m altitude over Vyshhorod (Kyiv region) on northern course. (Source: @eRadarrua/130562)
Chernihiv region: UAV past Snovsk; Cherkasy region: UAV on Talne/Mankivka. (Source: @eRadarrua/130512)

Russian missile/drone attacks on Odesa and Zaporizhzhia caused civilian casualties: 2 dead, 7 injured in Odesa; 1 dead (17yo), 13 injured including 5 children in Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @UkraineNow/85282)
Jet-powered UAV from Black Sea waters toward Mykolaiv/Odesa border region; another over Zaporizhzhia city. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78212)
Geran-5 missile struck Dnipro area; Shahed drones targeted Mykolaiv region from Black Sea. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78208)
UAVs from southern Ukraine moved north along Odesa-Mykolaiv border; from Mykolaiv region toward Kirovohrad region (Kropyvnytskyi). (Source: @kpszsu/95842, @mon1tor_ua/78208)
Kherson region air alert for 1 group of jet-powered UAVs. (Source: @eRadarrua/130540)

Massive Russian drone wave: 20+ Shahed/Geran-5 systems tracked simultaneously across 10+ Ukrainian regions, including Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Odesa. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78201, @mon1tor_ua/78209, @mon1tor_ua/78208)
